title: How Investors May Respond To WisdomTree (WT) Record 2025 Results And Tokenized Funds Expansion
text: In late January 2026, WisdomTree, Inc. reported higher full-year 2025 revenue of US$493.75 million and net income of US$109.13 million, while its board affirmed a quarterly cash dividend of US$0.03 per share payable on February 25, 2026. Alongside record assets under management and stronger margins, WisdomTree’s push into tokenized funds on blockchains such as Solana and its acquisition-driven expansion into U.S. farmland highlight a growing mix of traditional and digital asset...
